title: Electric light, power; inspection of; all wires to be inspected.
officialText: The commissioner of buildings shall cause all wires, currents and appliances that may be introduced into or placed in any building or structure in the city to be inspected, and shall furnish a certificate of such inspection to any person or corporation applying therefor.
